lines.text: David stays in Jerusalem while Joab besieges Rabbah, and David sends for Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, after seeing her bathing.
David sends for Uriah and tells him to go home, but Uriah sleeps at the palace door with the servants.
David invites Uriah to eat and drink with him and gets him drunk, so Uriah finally goes home to his wife.

wrong_details.wrong: Uriah finally goes home to his wife
wrong_details.true: Uriah lies down on his cot with his master's servants and does not go home

lines.text: David writes a letter to Joab, who puts Uriah where the strongest enemy soldiers are, and Uriah dies in Ammon's attack on Thebez.

wrong_details.true: Rabbah (Joab besieged the city of Rabbah)

lines.text: Bathsheba mourns her husband, then David brings her to his house, and she becomes his wife and bears him a son.
